issues: The note says 'Passed 12 August 2019', which conflicts with Parliament's own record. The Barbados Parliament bills archive (Data Protection Bill, 2019 (as amended), bill 417) shows the Senate passed the bill on 24/07/2019 and the House of Assembly on 06/08/2019, with Current Stage 'Passed'. Parliamentary passage was therefore complete on 6 August 2019. The 12 August 2019 date comes only from DLA Piper, which calls it the date the Act 'was passed'. It may be the assent date, but no primary text of Act 2019-29 could be read to confirm this: the Commissioner's site does not resolve, GIS Barbados is behind Cloudflare and the parliament's gazette archive for 2019 is incomplete. The note has been reworded so it no longer calls 12 August the passage date.

'In force March 2021' is supported only by DLA Piper, which also says 'Some provisions of the Act are yet to be proclaimed'. The note should keep that caveat. The exact commencement date (commonly given as 25 March 2021) was not verified at a primary source.
yearEnacted 2019 and inForce 2021 are correct. Coordinates (13.0975, -59.6165) are central Bridgetown, near Parliament Buildings. OK.

issues: The note wrongly says Law 7593/2025 replaces the credit-data regime (Law 6534/2020). The official text on the Congress library (BACN) shows only a partial repeal. Art. 59 repeals 'los incisos a) y b) del artículo 3º, el artículo 4º, el inciso b) del artículo 20, el inciso x) del artículo 21 de la Ley Nº 6534/2020'. Art. 58 transfers 6534's references to the consumer-protection secretariat to the new Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales. Law 6534/2020 therefore stays in force as the sectoral credit-data law alongside the new general law.

The note is vague about dates and says the 24-month vacatio legis is 'not verified'. BACN gives 'Fecha de Promulgación: 27-11-2025' and 'Fecha de Publicación: 27-11-2025'. Art. 57 reads 'La presente ley entrará en vigor luego de transcurridos veinticuatro meses de su publicación oficial', so the law takes effect around 27 November 2027. Congress sanctioned it with the Deputies on 14 October 2025 and the Senate on 5 November 2025.

The DLA Piper quote only named Law 6534/2020. The same page now also says 'In November of 2025, Congress approved the new Law No. 7593/25 ... It is set to take effect 24 months after its approval, i.e., in November of 2027', so the quote has been extended.

Context: the earlier Law 1682/2001 ('que reglamenta la información de carácter privado', promulgated 16 January 2001), later replaced by 6534/2020, was in practice a credit/information-bureau regime. Treating 7593/2025 as Paraguay's first comprehensive law is consistent with the slice definition. Coordinates (-25.2637, -57.5759) are Asunción, the capital. OK.

fieldFixes.note: Congress sanctioned the law in 2025 (Chamber of Deputies 14 October, Senate 5 November). It was promulgated and published on 27 November 2025 and enters into force 24 months after publication (Art. 57), in November 2027. It creates the Agencia Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales within MITIC. The credit-data law it complements (Law 6534/2020) remains in force, with a few provisions repealed (Art. 59).
